stage0051b_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$キャシー$$
「I've pinpointed our position!
　This is N23-32, E161-22!」

stage0051b_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$フェルト$$
「The current time is three weeks after
　the moment we were caught in the $$時空震動$$...!」

stage0051b_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「This wasn't just a dream we had... right?」

stage0051b_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$メラン$$
「$c, all units have been recovered aboard the ships.
　$$ロジャー・スミス$$, along with his attendant
　and butler, are also with us」

stage0051b_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ブライト$$
「$$ガドライト・メオンサム$$ is... lost, then...」

stage0051b_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「It seems you've touched the truth in Paradigm City」

stage0051b_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「You're... not one of Geminis' allies, are you?」

stage0051b_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「We are those who watch over humanity's evolution.
　What $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$ intends to do
　is not something we can allow」

stage0051b_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「So you knew.
　That this world's time is about to stop」

stage0051b_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「$$ミスリル$$ has apparently decided to call
　that phenomenon $$エタニティ・フラット$$」

stage0051b_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「So change along the timeline becomes eternally flat, is that it...」

stage0051b_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「But that doesn't mean no hope remains.
　...One of them is your existence」

stage0051b_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Next, head for the coordinates
　I'm about to transmit」

stage0051b_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Data confirmed, desu!
　This is... the waters near Earth, desu!」

stage0051b_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ラッセ$$
「You're saying we head up to space...!?」

stage0051b_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Just what do you know?」

stage0051b_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「All of this is my organization's doing.
　And believing you'll come to agree with us,
　I'm passing this information to you now」

stage0051b_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Once you've confirmed the truth with your own eyes,
　we'll likely find ourselves fighting side by side」

stage0051b_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Wait...!
　At least tell us your organization's name...!」

stage0051b_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Chrono...
　That is our name」

stage0051b_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Until we meet again, then...!」

stage0051b_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$かなめ$$
（That person calling himself $$アドヴェント$$...
　is he also a 《$$スフィア・リアクター$$》...）
